scope: Q7 v1.01 AF algorithm seam, lens-command compatibility, Q7 UI ABI and K-3 Mark III implementation gap. Evidence includes offline static data flow and bounded original-code replay.

estimator.input: a0 signed sample count; a1 points to little-endian signed i32 positions; a2 points to little-endian IEEE-754 binary32 contrast values.
estimator.output: v0 signed i32 position estimate. Count >= 11 returns 0 after scratch initialization and skips the sample pointers.
estimator.operation: Initialize fixed scratch, convert position i32 to binary32, copy contrast floats, compute sums and determinants, and return truncation-to-i32 of the fitted vertex B/(-2*A). The multiplier at 0x803b7c00 is binary64 -2.
estimator.global_scratch: Observed synthetic accesses were bounded to the fixed RAM span 0x80c24bd4..0x80c24f17. Initializer and helpers mutate scratch; replacement must preserve callers’ state assumptions.
estimator.call_site_constraints: A direct JAL target must be word-aligned in the 0x8xxxxxxx region and executable in the real Q7 layout. Preserve the original delay slot and O32 ABI. A reachable and safe location for new code has not been established.
estimator.recommended_first_scope: Use a call-site adapter for CalcFocus at 0x8037dccc to preserve the caller’s sample selection, lens-dependent corrections and the separate wobble call site. An entry replacement affects both direct call sites and possible indirect calls. Candidate only; no executable edit has been made.

caller.flow: AfMain_Thread_sub 0x80383dfc invokes CalcFocus at 0x80384f88 and stores its result to iFocusPos at 0x80c24bc4. For the shown branch it checks CalcFocus’s result against 0x8000, performs more lens-related correction, compares with returned LensLocationVDRC, and computes the delta for the mode-2 call at 0x8038502c.
caller.demonstrated_call: a0=2, a1=1, a2=0, a3=0x7d0, fifth stack argument is corrected position minus the stored reference for this branch.
caller.proposed_contract: Same positional units, signs and bounds, in-range initialized sample windows and explicit failure handling. Keep post-fit range/calibration, operation-specific return conventions, timeout, stop and completion behavior.

lens_abi.focus_control: CAutoFocusService_LensDriveControl 0x8037eb78 obtains tFocusControlInfo 0x80c6aad4 via 0x8042dd54. It writes a0.u8 at +0, a1.u8 at +1, a2.u8 at +2, a3.u16 at +4 and fifth O32 argument at +8 as u32.
lens_abi.notify: Initialized AF callback slot 0x80c17e00 is bound to CaptureProcessService_OnNotifyCommand 0x8040a008 on the verified startup path. LensDriveControl notifies (0x6003c,0); capture mode dispatcher 0x8042e040 reads the shared struct.

commands.payload: u8 at focus info+2, then big-endian u16 at +4
single zero byte in replayed worker
big-endian u32 at focus info+8, then big-endian u16 at +4
search format, pending state consumed after a separate eligible VD-sync event

lens_abi.guards: For mode 0/1/2 lower setters, LensService_GetLensActuatorDriveLimitModeEnable 0x8010f36c returning 1 prevents the queue send and yields status 8. The wait loops can return status 6 on the observed timeout path. Physical meanings of the payload units and link acknowledgements require lens-specific evidence.
lens_abi.existing_replay: lens-routing.json contains original focus mode/queue/transport-boundary traces. A RAM payload is not a captured wire frame.

af.hardware: Q7 contrast AF is image-sensor based. Pentax’s 01/02 Q-mount release describes AF motors in the lens barrel. Q7 manual supports AF with its listed high-performance group, while Unique-series and Adapter Q entries lack AF. The later 08 press release documents AF via Quick-Shift Focus. Adapter Q permits K-mount lenses in manual focus; changing the Q7 estimator cannot add a K-mount body AF coupler.
af.next_offline_check: Replay the CalcFocus call site with captured-or-synthetic valid windows and compare both scratch and downstream branch selection for ties, near-endpoint peaks, singular fits, out-of-range results and failure sentinel. Use the known focus-command replay to check ordering, completion flag, VD gating and timeout without a lens.

icons.binding: ResourceIcon_InitializeBootStill 0x8043f108 builds cached decoded offsets as prefix sums of u16 stored width × u16 height. RLE has 248 entries indexed by ID−1, Zoran has 546 entries indexed by ID−1001. The ID switch is 1001; the index helper does not itself validate the unused ID range.
icons.rle_record: 0x8043f42c decodes palette-index byte plus count. Data width <256 uses u8 count; width >=256 uses big-endian u16 count. The destination size is stored data width × height; replacement asset encoding must enforce exact output size and reject truncated/overlong streams offline.
icons.zoran: The draw routine requests shared decompression to the aligned buffer with size 0x4fc080 on first use and marks the family decoded. The aggregate decoder was not independently replayed.
icons.size_abi: 0x8043f288 writes (u16 original width, u16 height) to the result pointer; 0x8043f3a4 returns the u16 stored width. Rendering selects stored width; layout widths are a separate field.

menu_input.menu: CaptureMenu1Mode_BuildUp 0x80a308e4 constructs a root canvas with component ID 0x1b00000 and child components. StartMode 0x80a32810 initializes those objects and queries setting IDs 0x5e (HDR), 0x65 (focus), and 0x5c (AE) through 0x80430cb4. HandleSwitchDown 0x80a320f0 uses numeric key IDs and current focus component to route actions.
menu_input.input: SwitchService_OnNotifyCommand 0x803f9c58 and UiSwitchInformation_Get4wayKeyOnEdge 0x80ae0614 expose physical-switch event producers. GuiComponent_OfferKeyEvent 0x80ac8594 indexes table 0x80b7b334 by component type and calls slot +0x50. The canvas type 1 binding is 0x809bcf2c→0x80aca4dc and popup type 2 is 0x809bce9c→0x80acc5b8. This is a bounded component-side input route; the complete switch-to-menu dispatch was not replayed.
menu_input.canvas_layout: On the canvas handler, a1 is a component pointer whose +0 type must equal 1, +8 is the internal canvas pointer, and canvas+4 is the focused child. It delegates the event to that child first, then consults the active child list at canvas+0xc and its byte count at +9 for focus movement.
menu_input.text: ResourceString_ChangeLanguage 0x80ac5cb8 uses a language enum and font-pool state. ResourceString_DrawString 0x80ac644c has a dedicated text/palette route. The icon table is not a drop-in substitute for the language and font resources.

display.output: ScreenControl_TransScreenModeToOutput 0x80439248 maps screen mode 2 to output 1; IsOutputLcd 0x80439384 compares output with 1. GetScreenSize 0x80439428 returns the packed logical pair 960×480 for that seeded LCD mode from 0x804e86d0. It is an internal geometry, separate from the physical panel dot count.
display.pixel: LCD branch of ResourceIcon_DrawIcon 0x8043f42c calls DirectOsdGetBuffer 0x80262fd4 for base plus u16 context width and height. The icon loop writes a single palette index byte at base + (y+row)*width + x+col. Index 0 preserves the destination, style 1 preserves index 1 and replaces other nonzero indices with the supplied recolor value.
display.palette: ScreenOsdLayer_SetColorPallet 0x8043c114 builds 256 entries and applies palette selection to draw/show layers. The GDI bitmap interface carries a separate format byte at bitmap+8, so the 8-bit indexed conclusion is specific to this LCD overlay path.
display.check: Original VEX replays 5 geometry IDs across both banks, LCD reported geometry, and 2 style draws using one synthetic DirectOsdGetBuffer stub. The encoded bytes, metadata and icon instructions came from the SHA-pinned image.

ui.minimum_change: For visual-only changes retain existing icon IDs, widths, cache budgets, palette conventions and text/font bindings, or add a verified bounded renderer for a single Q7 screen. For K-3 III-like navigation rebuild one list using Q7 canvas components, setting IDs, four-way/e-dial/OK/MENU events and the indexed OSD. Touch gestures and the Smart Function dial need a different control mapping on the available Q7 inputs.
ui.next_offline_check: Validate table counts, bounds and relocation before rendering new assets. Differentially replay transparent/recolor/padded rows, AV/HDMI transforms, menu focus/scroll/confirm/cancel, locale text fitting and camera-setting read/write stubs. Compare framebuffer hashes and event/setting traces while preserving unknown resources.

implementation_gap.redesign: Recreate K-3 III hierarchy, vertical scroll, typography and icons on Q7 logical coordinates and palette.
implementation_gap.binary_transplant: K-3 III UI design expects a different LCD and touch interaction; both can affect control/layout even before binary compatibility.

implementation_gap.redesign: Re-encode authored art to Q7’s ID/geometry/palette/cache rules and use the Q7 language and glyph path.
implementation_gap.binary_transplant: The studied K-3 III ICONBIN loader has a different boot record/readiness/storage ABI. K-3 III resource internals beyond the linked evidence are unresolved; interchangeability with Q7’s embedded tables is not shown.

implementation_gap.redesign: Implement against Q7 MIPS O32, Q7 callback/object addresses, Q7 settings and RTOS.
implementation_gap.binary_transplant: Q7 MIPS32LE instructions and fixed object/handler addresses differ from K-3 III ARM/Thumb evidence. Even translated instructions need reconstructed object layouts, resources, settings and hardware services.

trace_limitations: Extents end at the next distinct sidecar address, not a typed ELF function size.
Linear MIPS32 word scan; edges are instruction candidates, not proof of reachability.
Delay slots are included in extents. Register-indirect targets are unresolved.
A jump is recorded as a transfer, not automatically a function call.
limitations: The AF fit replay covers six synthetic integer/quadratic windows; it does not validate scene sampling, focus tracking, physical travel, motor types, timing, or lens wire protocol.
The firmware-side actuator argument widths and stack bytes are established at known boundaries. No lens, camera or update image was executed.

Original indexed icon replay covers one embedded RLE icon and two styles with a synthetic buffer getter. It does not replay the Zoran decoder, full GUI event lifecycle, palette hardware, camera output or touch emulation.
The K-3 Mark III cross-model comparison uses linked official documentation and existing separately pinned public analysis. It does not attempt conversion, binary relocation, flash or a boot test.
